name: Arah
overview: Arah is a male member of the tribe of Asher, identified in Scripture as the son of Ulla, who is also known as Jephunneh. His mention is brief and specific, providing a genealogical link within the tribe of Asher. Beyond this, no additional notes or details are recorded about his life or actions.
namesAndTitles: The name Arah means 'he wanders' in Hebrew. It is a proper name given to this individual, though the Scriptures do not indicate that it was given directly by God. This meaning may reflect a characteristic or circumstance at the time of naming, but the text does not elaborate further.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records that Arah is the son of Jephunneh, also called Ulla. No other family relationships are detailed beyond this paternal connection in the biblical record.
scriptureSignificance: Arah's significance lies primarily in his place within the genealogical records of the tribe of Asher, as noted in 1 Chronicles 7:39. His inclusion helps preserve the lineage and tribal identity important to God's covenant people. While not prominent in narrative events, his mention contributes to the faithful transmission of Israel's family lines, which ultimately point to God's providential care over His chosen people.
